Rule Name: Proper use of const and final
What to Check / Trigger Condition: If widget not updated once declear and vaeriable value will never change once declear then use const and final with decration
Trigger when a file has more than 500 non-empty, non-comment code lines
Recommendation: Split large files into smaller focused units

What to Check / Trigger Condition: Trigger when a class exceeds configured LOC threshold
Trigger when a function/method exceeds configured LOC threshold
Declared widget/class/function has no references
Recommendation: Remove unused code or document intentional public APIs

What to Check / Trigger Condition: Imported symbol is never referenced
Branch can never execute based on static control-flow analysis
Function exceeds complexity threshold
Similar code block exceeds configured similarity threshold
Build method exceeds configured size
Recommendation: Extract widgets and separate UI/business logic

What to Check / Trigger Condition: Widget tree nesting exceeds threshold
State update potentially rebuilds unnecessarily large widget subtree
Constructor/widget can safely be const but is not
Local variable never reassigned and can be final
late variable may be accessed before initialization or is unnecessary
Recommendation: Avoid unnecessary late and initialize safely

What to Check / Trigger Condition: Classes, variables, methods/files violate Dart naming conventions
Catch block has no meaningful handling/logging/rethrow
Recommendation: Handle, propagate, or intentionally document errors

What to Check / Trigger Condition: API key pattern detected in source/config
Payment provider private/secret credential detected
Recommendation: Never ship private payment credentials in client

What to Check / Trigger Condition: Firebase service-account JSON/private key detected
Recommendation: Remove, rotate and keep credentials server-side

What to Check / Trigger Condition: PEM/private key/signing material detected
Access/refresh tokens stored in SharedPreferences/plain files
Non-TLS HTTP endpoint or cleartext platform configuration detected
Recommendation: Use HTTPS and disable cleartext traffic

What to Check / Trigger Condition: Client bypasses certificate validation
JavaScript/file access/untrusted navigation enabled without controls
Recommendation: Restrict navigation, sources and JS capabilities

What to Check / Trigger Condition: Unsafe eval-like/dynamic deserialization or execution pattern detected
Token/password/payment/PII passed to logging APIs
Recommendation: Remove sensitive logs or redact values

What to Check / Trigger Condition: Debuggable release config, exported components or permissive network settings
ATS exceptions, insecure entitlements or overly permissive settings
Recommendation: Minimize exceptions and harden release settings

What to Check / Trigger Condition: Firestore/Realtime Database allows broad unauthenticated read/write
StreamSubscription created without matching cancellation/disposal
Timer created without cancellation
AnimationController created in State without dispose
TextEditingController retained without disposal
ScrollController/PageController created without disposal
addListener/addObserver without matching remove
StatefulWidget has no mutable state or lifecycle requirement
Immutable widget does not use const constructor
Long-lived callback captures State/BuildContext
List/map/cache grows without size/eviction control
Recommendation: Bound cache size and implement eviction

What to Check / Trigger Condition: Heap increases across repeated flows and does not return toward baseline
Recommendation: Identify retained objects and lifecycle leaks

What to Check / Trigger Condition: Objects remain retained after route/widget disposal
Recommendation: Find retaining references and dispose/remove listeners

What to Check / Trigger Condition: Frame build/raster time exceeds threshold or dropped frames detected
Recommendation: Reduce rebuilds and expensive UI/raster work

What to Check / Trigger Condition: Widget rebuild count significantly exceeds expected baseline
Cold-start time exceeds configured threshold
API request exceeds latency threshold
Recommendation: Cache, batch, debounce or optimize API calls

What to Check / Trigger Condition: Unexpected request frequency or payload volume
Unhandled Dart/Flutter exception during test flow
Recommendation: Handle expected failures and improve error boundaries

What to Check / Trigger Condition: Subscription/timer remains active after navigation away
Token/payment/PII written to logs or insecure storage
Recommendation: Use secure storage and redact telemetry

What to Check / Trigger Condition: Direct/transitive dependency has known security advisory
Recommendation: Upgrade, replace or pin to safe version

What to Check / Trigger Condition: Declared package has no project references
Package has stale releases or weak maintenance signals
UI directly accesses infrastructure/data layer against selected architecture
Conflicting state-management patterns used across modules
Networking/business rules embedded in build/UI classes
Every finding must include exact source location and evidence snippet
Every finding receives severity and confidence
Approved findings can be suppressed with a reason
Recommendation: Support project-level exclusions with audit trail
